title: Vue 3 <ais-dynamic-widgets> does not work with child v-for <ais-panel>s
explanation: The issue describes a bug in the Vue 3 implementation of the `<ais-dynamic-widgets>` component, where it does not work as expected with child `<ais-panel>` components using `v-for`. The user has provided clear steps to reproduce the issue and the expected behavior, indicating frustration with the technical difficulties and confusion around the change in behavior from Vue 2 to Vue 3.
